&Beyond
Kichwa Tembo Tented Camp
Quintessential Big Five safari with a spacious, classic feel
Condé Nast Traveller Readers’ Choice Awards 2025
Best Resorts in Central and Eastern Africa
Unbroken skies and sweeping savanna.
Tree-dotted plains roll to the horizon. Wildlife moves in astonishing numbers. In the Masai Mara National Reserve, space stretches as far as the eye can see. But in one corner, tucked beneath the forested Oloololo escarpment, where the Great Rift Valley begins and Out of Africa took its final bow, safari becomes personal. A piece of the Mara, just for you, and your family.
—
Explore the destination
Go where the wild runs beyond the horizon and the memories run even deeper.
—
A beloved retreat, rich with legacy.
This is where the &Beyond story in Kenya began. Set on a concession bordering the Masai Mara National Reserve, Kichwa Tembo is not just a camp, but a homecoming. A place where stories are passed down, culture comes alive, and familiar smiles greet you by name.
—
Luxury in the wild
Heritage meets hospitality in the heart of the Mara.
Under canvas, sophistication meets simplicity. Set among manicured lawns, where warthogs wander freely and every sunrise feels like a private show, Kichwa Tembo’s Maasai-inspired design and warm, organic textures ground you in a place that feels as eternal as present.
—
Stay with us
Safari, your way.
Each day is a new chapter, from Big Five game drives and hot air ballooning to Maasai cultural visits and sundowners beside the Mara River. Experiencing the Mara is an adventure quite unlike any other.
—
Uncover every adventure
The adventure isn’t just out there. It’s in every insight shared.
—
Journeys made just for you.
Your time at Kichwa Tembo is only the beginning. Let our Travel Specialists craft a journey that’s entirely yours.
Recognised for what matters.
Beyond awards and acclaim lies something rarer: genuine connection, intuitive care , and a legacy of impact that lives on long after the journey ends.
Discover more.

About us
Journey with us, and together we’ll leave our world a better place
Our vision
We strive to leave our world a better place than we found it through our Care of the Land, Wildlife and People, and the delivery of guest experiences that go beyond the expected in Africa, Asia and South America.
Established in 1991, &Beyond are bespoke tour operators for sub-Saharan Africa , Asia , South America and Antarctica. We also own and manage 29 extraordinary lodges and camps across three continents.
It is at these touch points where you, as our guest, enable us to positively impact 75 communities and directly conserve our footprint of 1 million acres.
Our impact model
We believe that travel has the power to transform. Extraordinary experiences transform you, our guest, while your support is the foundation that allows us to leave our world a better place by transforming the land, wildlife and people of the beautiful places in which we operate.
From our greater conservation model down to the tiniest details of the activities that take place in our lodges every day, every decision that we make revolves around our core ethic of Care of the Land, Care of the Wildlife and Care of the People.
Impact and business strategies are fully integrated in our proven impact model.
Our Phinda Story
The dream is born at Phinda
It all started in 1991 with the creation of Phinda Private Game Reserve, KwaZulu-Natal, South Africa. Phinda, meaning ‘the return’ in Zulu, has become the most compelling realisation of our dream to create sustainable conservation through responsible tourism.
Our milestones
A lot can happen in 30 years.
In this time, our operation has expanded across Africa, Asia and South America and our impact model has evolved to influence the 3.6 million hectares (9 million acres) of land and 3,000 km (1 864 mi.) of African coastline under our custodianship.
Celebrating 30 years of milestones
The power of 3: Tripling our impact
30 year Limited-edition experiences
Our gift to you; this series of limited edition experiences are hosted by &Beyond storytellers (from specialist guides, conservationists, and locals) who will showcase and/or re-live some of our most significant milestones and collaborations of our 30-year legacy.
An early lesson was that we could expand our influence by forming coalitions with like-minded organisations
Our coalitions
Our understanding of the compounded impact that is set in motion when working collaboratively with like-minded organisations has deep roots. Africa Foundation, our non-profit community development partner since 1992, has been a cornerstone of our community milestones, with subsequent coalitions each playing a fundamental role in our impact journey.
The &Beyond Way
Leaving our staff in a better place through a set of growth and development programmes, The &Beyond Way has roots 18-years deep.
In 2021, this commitment was taken to another level with the launch of an industry first: our formally accredited &Beyond Academy, which was three years in the making. Built on the foundation of our training philosophy, &Beyonders now have the opportunity of receiving accredited qualifications as they work.
Our impact reviews
Our 30th Anniversary has been a pivotal marker between our Vision 2020 review of the successes and learnings that have shaped our journey to date, and the ambitiously scaled impact of our Vision 2030:
Vision 2020
Vision 2030
Reviews and resources
Travel has evolved from the adage of taking only photos and leaving only footprints. The world’s wild places need us to do better than that. Now it’s about taking memories and leaving a legacy.
Why travel with &Beyond
Responsible travel has a broad reach. It touches on each and every aspect of sustainable, conscious, intentional, purposeful, eco, green, ethical and regenerative travel. In travelling with &Beyond , you are an active co-creator in leaving our world a better place.

Luxury in the wild
This is safari with soul.
Sprawled along the Saparingo River at the foot of the Oloololo Escarpment, where riverine forest meets open plains, Kichwa Tembo is perfectly positioned to witness the Great Migration. Meaning “head of the elephant” in Kiswahili, it sits in the remote western Mara, on land leased from Maasai landlords and explored almost exclusively by our guests. Here, panoramic views and intimate wildlife encounters meet legendary Kenyan warmth, offering a fresh lens on a timeless safari.
Contemporary style, classic spirit.
Steeped in the aura of the traditional safari, Kichwa Tembo blends nostalgia with a crisp, modern style. This is a camp designed to feel like home. A generous swimming pool sits beneath shady trees with views across the plains. The split-level dining area centres around an interactive kitchen and thriving shamba, where food becomes part of the adventure.
A favourite for all ages.
Designed for memory-making across generations. Interleading tents, intuitive care and child-friendly experiences make it easy to explore together. The WILDchild programme connects young adventurers to nature and culture, while trusted childminders offer peace of mind when you need it.
Maasai spirit lived daily.
This is Maasai land: a culture as enduring as the landscape itself. Many of our team are from nearby communities, and their presence shapes every stay. It s the spirit of the place. Visit a traditional Maasai village or simply listen as daily rituals unfold beside you.
Welcomed like family.
It is the people who bring this place to life. Our team welcome guests not as strangers, but as family. Their stories, their care and their pride add soul to every stay.
Gather at Tusker Bar.
Named after the legendary Kenyan beer, the Tusker Bar is the beating heart of the camp. Gather here for high tea before your afternoon game drive, revel in a traditional Maasai performance before dinner or enjoy a fireside drink with your guides afterwards.
Made with meaning.
A curated Safari Shop showcases locally crafted décor, soft Kenana knits and fashion that reflects the Mara’s spirit. Pick up beaded Maasai jewellery and handcrafted pieces by Saparingo, small treasures shaped by tradition and care.
From shamba to table.
Wholesome menus are shaped by the seasonal bounty of our organic garden. Pick your own ingredients, then watch as they become vibrant meals prepared in the interactive kitchen. It s food that connects: fresh and full of heart.
Shared journeys, unforgettable bonds.
Whether celebrating a milestone, reconnecting with friends or gathering as a family, Kichwa Tembo is the perfect setting for groups to come together. Spacious tents, flexible dining and tailored experiences make every moment feel personal. From migration routes to guided bush walks and night drives, these wild spaces are yours to discover.
Conferencing in the wild.
With several indoor and outdoor spaces available, including the area above the bar, Kichwa Tembo can accommodate conferences and small events. Facilities include Wi-Fi, a projector and an interactive TV room.
